name: Technique - Growl open-close and filter
description: Standalone technique from the growl checklist: growl wavetable, open-close LFO, band-pass notch filter and a separate pitch-bend LFO.

manual.instruction: Load a growl wavetable at bass octave and move the wavetable position. Use one LFO on position and choose an open-close shape: long open for a growl, instant open then close for a gun.
manual.verify: The patch has a clear vowel-like open and close, not random wavetable chatter.
manual.why: Oddprophet's one-LFO open-close is the core of the 1-2-3 growl method.

manual.instruction: Add a band-pass notch filter and attach the LFO to cutoff. Keep the movement musical rather than wide and random.
manual.verify: The growl talks while the fundamental rhythm stays intact.
manual.why: Oddprophet uses band-pass notch as the main subtractive filter for growls.

manual.instruction: Use a second LFO on global main tuning for a small pitch bend. Keep the amount subtle; the growl should bend, not detune into noise.
manual.verify: The pitch movement supports the growl without destroying its pitch center.
manual.why: Oddprophet adds a separate pitch-bend LFO to global main tuning.

notes: Sources: oddprophet, 'I Made A 1-2-3 Method For Dubstep Sound Design...' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OwQDpCtbNTM); Dripment, '2 TEAROUT Serum 2 BASS ROUTINES' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NRfK34KZIf8). Transcript summaries, not quotes.
